answer: Each identity claims one canyon timber plot, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it pays a harvest tax: first plot 30 credits, the k-th plot per key 30+6(k-1). A canyon auditor sends each plot a whisper, a signed check answered with a timber tally; a missed whisper burns the bond and a rented-plot ring fails the check. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,027,000 per epoch plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. One honest plot costs 30, bond refunded.
